join.point-forward: They will see the reports you file from now on — which polling unit, and when. Your earlier reports stay yours.
join.point-public: They cannot see anything the public cannot. Joining only tells them which published reports are yours.
join.point-anywhere: They may suggest a polling unit. You can still report from wherever you actually are.
join.point-leave: You can leave whenever you want, and you can be in more than one group.
join.point-leave-where: Every group you are in is listed under {link}.
join.fine-print: Hawkeye is not run by any party, candidate or campaign, and joining a group does not change how your reports are checked or counted.
join.could-not-join-offline: Could not join — check your connection and try again.
my-groups.have-link-sub: Paste the link a campaign or observer group sent you.
my-groups.bad-link: That is not a Hawkeye invite link. Copy the whole link and try again.
my-groups.check-connection: Check your connection and try again.
my-groups.decline-confirm: Tell {name} you will not be at this unit? They can suggest another one. You cannot undo this here.
situation-room.codes-pending: Organisation codes can be checked here once Hawkeye has verified this room.
situation-room.codes-no-issuer: Organisation codes are not set up for {v0} yet. Hawkeye sets them up on request, the same way for every party and organisation.
situation-room.room-deleted-note: {name} was deleted. Its observers’ reports stay in the public record.
situation-room.read-only-title-cso: You are on this observer group’s roster.
situation-room.no-live-links: No live links. Nobody new can join until you create one.
